title: Public TiN dataset intake

dataset.title: Low-temperature fabrication of plasmonic titanium nitride thin films by electron beam evaporation (dataset)

paper.citation_short: Das et al., Journal of Physics: Photonics 7, 025032 (2025)
mapping_notes: Paper describes 50 nm TiN films on glass.
Paper states Figure 4 is unpolarized transmittance and reflectance at normal incidence.
Paper states reflectance minimum is about 20% near 540 nm.
RT.xlsx reflectance minimum in 400-1000 nm is 0.20377 at 542.06 nm.

remaining_blockers: Exact RT.xlsx to ellipsometry-table pairing is not yet locked.
No residual threshold policy has been predeclared for this dataset.
No loader or experiment spec has been added for RT.xlsx yet.
The dataset can become a validation candidate only after no-fit-leakage and sample-pairing policy are explicit.

recommended_next_phase.name: St Andrews TiN Pairing + Validation Candidate Plan
helpful_tools: Consensus MCP if literature support for validation metrics is needed
